items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I know, like [Braud] used to do. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, yeah.

ctx.x: I'll tell you about that. But I got the teacher, it was a German teacher there, in Omaha, Nebraska. So I took two lessons. What I wanted to learn how to do was slap the bass, (singing) one of those things, like --
I know, like [Braud] used to do.
